paragraphs.text: Bodyguard is an obsolete class . A bodyguard is a person or group of persons employed to guard an individual, often a high official or VIP, from bodily harm.

Cards printed with the class Bodyguard were Veteran Bodyguard from Alpha , Martyrs of Korlis from Antiquities and Anaba Bodyguard from Homelands . In the Grand Creature Type Update , the class was obsoleted, and they were changed to Human and Minotaur respectively. Later cards like Rhox Bodyguard from Conflux were always Soldiers or Clerics .
Burke was a bodyguard for Ambassador Laquatus , and Chainer was asked to be a bodyguard for the Cabal Patriarch right before killing him.
